text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just before the Satsuki Sho, Maruzensky tells me that running has lost all of its joy for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take the melancholy Maruzensky to watch the younger students as they train hard, trying to catch up to their role model.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week and Grass Wonder happily train late into the evening, dreaming of someday catching up to Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing them, Maruzensky realizes that her running has the power to inspire people and bring them joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To set an example for the other students, Maruzensky becomes determined to run her heart out at the Satsuki Sho.
